استطلعا (form X)
# اِسْتَطْلَعَا (istaṭlaʕā) /is.tatˤ.la.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اُسْتُطْلِعَا (ustuṭliʕā) /us.tutˤ.li.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اِسْتَطْلِعَا (istaṭliʕā) /is.tatˤ.li.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
